summary: The team noted multiple user complaints about the navigation.
A proposal to simplify the sidebar was raised.
The group agreed to prioritize a navigation redesign in the next sprint.
John was tasked with delivering new wireframes by Friday, and the authentication system decision was deferred for discussion with the backend team.
